Minister of OVERSEAS INDIAN

(a) whether it is a fact that the number

MINISTER be pleased to state:

most of the major rivers has become black

to deal with the said problem have proved
infructuous;

Melting of ice in upper region of Tibet

MISHRA:
SHRI BRIJ BHUSHAN

Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that rapid melting

Upgradation of services by DoP

SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of

pleased to state:
(a) whether in view of the burgeoning
competition from private courier
companies, the Department of Posts has
embarked upon a major strategy to rejig its

reliable and more responsive services to

Accident database

the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD

pleased to state:
(a) whether the Sundar Committee

road accidents injuries and mortality was
both inadequate and scattered;

Economic and Social Commission for Asia
and the Pacific (UNESCAP) has come
forward to fund a project to build an accident
database; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Colachal Port
*247. DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a joint venture
agreement was entered into for
development of Colachal Port with Klana
Port of Malaysia;

is to be completed;
(c) the present stage and progress of
the project;
(d) whether there are any constraints in
the completion of the project;

over such problems; and

minor ports in Tamil Nadu?

BHARTIA: W ill the Minister of
EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether boundary talks between
India and China had made significant

peaceful and tranquil and whether this issue
was discussed with the Chinese President
during his recent visit to India;

discussed;

boundary issue was signed; and

New CZM Notification
*249. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
SHRI D. RAJA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have made a new Coastal Zone
Management (CZM) Notification replacing
the Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ)
Notification, 1991;

Notification;

the new CZM Notification poses serious

Most polluted rivers
†*250. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY: Will the PRIME MINISTER  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the name of
the Ganges has been included in the list of
ten most polluted rivers of the world;
(b) if so, the measures Government
intend to take to prevent such unfortunate
situations; and
(c) whether it is a fact that just before
the Magha fair, the waste polluted and
black water is released knowingly in the
holy Ganges by the leather factories of
Kanpur?
Road-bridge on Brahmaputra
*251. KUMAR DEEPAK DAS: Will
the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal for
construction of road-bridge downstream of
existing rail and road-bridge over
Brahmaputra at Saraighat near Guwahati;
(b) whether it is a fact that the Railway
authorities have requested to review the
planning for construction of roadbridge or
rail-cum-road bridge near Guwahati by
involving the Ministry of Railways; and

so far?

operators
*252. SHRI DEVDAS APTE: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
announced that identity of mobile users
would be verified by mobile operators;
(b) whether the deadline of 31st March,
2007 was fixed in this matter;
(c) whether this deadline has been
extended; and
(d) if not, the number of mobile
operators who were detected as defaulters?

pleased to state:

people have lost their lives while extracting
coal from abandoned coal mines in
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Jharkhand and other coal mines in the last

(c) the measures which have been taken

the country?
Pollution in Yamuna
†*254. SHRI DATTA MEGHE:
SHRI SANJAY RAUT:
 Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Yamuna
Development Authority has been set up
for cleaning the River Yamuna, wherein all
those bodies and people have been included
who are associated with its cleaning work
in one way or the other;

success in the implementation of the
schemes meant for cleaning the River
Yamuna so far;
(c) whether any action plan has been
drawn after detailed study of the increasing
pollution in River Yamuna; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Sea-worthiness of ships and boats
*255. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government expect an
increase in the number of ships and occean
plying vessels using Indian ports over the
next ten years;
(b) whether Director-General of
Shipping is the sole maritime authority to
determine "sea-worthiness" of all vessels
flying the Indian flag or using Indian ports
as a base;
(c) the manner in which Director-
General, Shipping determines whether a
large ship or fishing boat is "sea-worthy";
(d) whether it is a fact that there are
complaints on the un-predictable pattern
of behaviour of the personnel of Director-
General, Shipping in making inspections
and suggestions; and
(e) the steps proposed to assess the
work of all surveyors on their pattern of
work?
Telephone connections by 2010
*256. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI UDAY PRATAP
SINGH:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have set a
target of 250 million telephone connections
by 2007 and 500 million by 2010;
(b) whether the pace of providing
telephones is sufficient to meet these targets
and whether Government propose to
introduce more operators for achieving it;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) if not, the reasons therefor;
(e) whether Government propose to
make it compulsory for all the operators to
make use of all technologies for achieving
spectral efficiency and thereby requiring
less spectrum which would help in
introducing more competition; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?

JNNURM
†*257. SHRI AJAY MAROO: Will the
Minister of URBAN DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the names of such parts of Ranchi,
the capital of Jharkhand, and other cities of
the State which have been included for
improvement under the Jawaharlal Nehru
National Urban Renewal Mission;
(b) the details of the amount allocated
for Jharkhand under this scheme and by

(c) whether there is any difficulty in

*258. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of PANCHAYATI RAJ be
pleased to state:

panchayati raj in most of the States is a

(b) by when panchayati raj would be
really successful in people's projects in rural
areas?
Coastal Zone Management Authority
in Goa

LAXMAN NAIK: Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Goa Coastal Zone
Management Authority has started ground
level survey as well as house to house
verification of dwelling units and all other
constructions in the Coastal Regulation
Zone-III area, in order to identify the
structures that were constructed after
February 19, 1991;
(b) whether the survey has been
completed;
(c) whether the authority has submitted
its report;
(d) whether any action has been taken
in that regard; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?

†*260. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that pollution
has been increasing in various rivers

crores of rupees;

employed to make the three rivers of
Europe viz. Thames, Rhines and Danube,

ones, but now pollution-free;
(c) whether any high level enquiry has
been conducted into the matter of making
these holy rivers in India pollution-free;
(d) whether the agencies responsible for
the same have been punished; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
